demos.title: WebMCP Counterpart
demos.teaches: Expose the running app to a browser agent with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool() from @angular/core. Register two live tools, read the tools/list payload an agent would see, and watch registration no-op where no model context exists.

demos.title: Signals as WebMCP Tools
demos.teaches: Expose a signal value and its setter to an AI agent with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool() and register page-level tools with provideExperimentalWebMcpTools().

demos.title: WebMCP in Components
demos.teaches: Register agent tools from inside a component with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool so the tool closes over the component signals and unregisters with the component.

demos.title: Form as an Agent Tool
demos.teaches: Expose a Signal Form to a browser agent: provideExperimentalWebMcpForms() plus the experimentalWebMcpTool option on form(), and an explicit read tool via declareExperimentalWebMcpTool().

demos.title: WebMCP Store Tools
demos.teaches: Expose SignalStore methods to a browser agent with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool. Each tool declares a JSON schema and calls the same store method the UI calls.

demos.title: WebMCP Navigation Tools
demos.teaches: Expose application navigation to an AI agent as WebMCP tools declared with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool, scoped to the component that owns them.

demos.title: WebMCP E2E
demos.teaches: Declare page tools with declareExperimentalWebMcpTool and test them the way an agent would call them: a Vitest spec against a stubbed model context, and a Playwright run that invokes the tools and asserts the rendered page.

markdownItems.title: Tools are the contract
markdownItems.comment: A WebMCP tool declares a JSON schema and calls the same method the UI calls, so the agent and the user share one path.

markdownItems.title: Scope tools to the component
markdownItems.comment: declareExperimentalWebMcpTool registers while the component lives, so the agent only sees the tools of the page it is on.
